units.source_text: 昨儿，我女儿女婿一起去若狭，没想到会遭此横祸，造孽啊！

en.t: Yesterday, my daughter and son-in-law went together to Wakasa, and I never imagined they would meet with such a disaster. What a cruel fate!

units.source_text: 女婿已经故去，我只能接受了，但是我女儿呢？

en.t: My son-in-law is already dead, and I can only accept that. But what about my daughter?
I am truly beside myself with worry.

units.source_text: 我这老婆子恳求您，求您一定要找到我的女儿，大恩大德没齿难忘。

en.t: This old woman begs you. Please, you must find my daughter, and I will never forget your great kindness.

units.source_text: 无论如何，那个该死的多襄丸，他杀害了我女婿，我女儿也……

en.t: Whatever else may be true, that damned Tajomaru killed my son-in-law, and my daughter too...
The old woman breaks down crying and can no longer speak.
